searchText: EIP status of "stagnant" - what does that mean? Specifically https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-1898.md - Geth and Besu have at least partially implemented this - but it's not in the RPC spec - should these changes be rolled back so that clients match the spec? i means the author fell off somewhere on the path to finalization and the eip hasn't seen a change ~6+ months I recommend making a PR to `execution-apis` if 1898 isn't account for there!
